name: openclaw-control-plane
description: Fleet control plane for the multi-cell OpenClaw enclave

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ocp/domain && npm run build -w @ocp/gateway-client && npm run build -w @ocp/api && npm run build -w @ocp/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @ocp/api & npm run dev -w @ocp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ocp/domain && npm run typecheck -w @ocp/gateway-client && npm run typecheck -w @ocp/api && npm run typecheck -w @ocp/web
scripts.test: npm run test:gateway-client && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
